description_en: Use this API to retrieve the pre-upgrade check report for a major version upgrade of RDS MySQL and RDS PostgreSQL
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS MySQL及RDS PostgreSQL大版本升级前检查的检查报告
name: DescribeUpgradeMajorVersionPrecheckTask

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query this ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values:

30 (default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
表示大版本升级前，检查报告每页显示的记录数。

取值范围：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
表示显示升级前检查报告的页码。

取值范围：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The major engine version to which you want to upgrade the instance. This version must be later than the current major engine version of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例版本。必须大于当前实例版本
parameters.name: target_major_version

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pre-upgrade check task. The UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersionPrecheck operation returns this ID in the TaskId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 升级前检查任务ID，调用UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersionPrecheck接口执行升级前检查后，从返回参数TaskId中获取
parameters.name: task_id

Items.description_en: The properties of the major version upgrade precheck report
Items.description_zh: 大版本升级检查报告属性列表

items.description_en: The details of the major version upgrade precheck report
items.description_zh: 大版本升级检查报告详情

CheckTime.description_en:
The time when the precheck was performed.

The time follows the UNIX time format. The time is displayed in UTC. Unit: milliseconds
CheckTime.description_zh:
检查时间。

以Unix时间戳表示。单位：毫秒

Detail.description_en: The content of the major version upgrade precheck report
Detail.description_zh: 大版本升级检查报告内容

EffectiveTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the precheck report.

The time follows the UNIX time format. The time is displayed in UTC. Unit: milliseconds
EffectiveTime.description_zh:
检查报告到期时间。

以Unix时间戳表示。单位：毫秒

RecommendDiskSize.description_en:
The recommended minimum storage capacity that is required for the major engine version upgrade. Unit: GB.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
RecommendDiskSize.description_zh:
升级时，推荐的最小磁盘容量。单位：GB。

仅RDS PostgreSQL实例会返回该参数

RecommendLeastMemSize.description_en:
The recommended minimum memory that is required for the major engine version upgrade. Unit: GB.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
RecommendLeastMemSize.description_zh:
升级时，推荐的最小内存。单位：GB。

仅RDS PostgreSQL实例会返回该参数

RecommendMemSize.description_en:
The recommended memory for the major engine version upgrade. Unit: GB.

If the memory of the instance is greater than or equal to the recommended memory, the upgrade proceeds at maximum speed to minimize the read-only time of the instance.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
RecommendMemSize.description_zh:
升级时，推荐内存。单位：GB。

当实例的内存大于或等于推荐内存，将以最快的速度进行升级，以尽量减少实例的只读时间。

仅RDS PostgreSQL实例会返回该参数

Result.description_en:
The result of the major version upgrade precheck.

Valid values:

Success: The precheck is successful.

Fail: The precheck fails.

Warning: The precheck is successful but a warning is reported. You can view the precheck report to determine whether to upgrade the major engine version.

If the value of this parameter is Fail, you must check the value of the Detail parameter, fix the reported issues, and then try again. For more information about common issues and solutions, see [Understand the major version upgrade check report for an RDS for PostgreSQL instance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/218391.html）
Result.description_zh:
大版本升级检查的检查结果。

取值范围：
Success：成功
Fail：失败
warning：警告，需要查看报告，确定是否继续升级

当检查结果为Fail时，请排查Detail的参数取值，处理报错后再试，常见报错及处理方法，请参见[解读RDS PostgreSQL大版本升级检查报告]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/218391.html）

SourceMajorVersion.description_en: The original major engine version of the instance

TargetMajorVersion.description_en: The major engine version of the instance to which you want to upgrade

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the major version upgrade precheck task
TaskId.description_zh: 大版本升级前检查任务ID

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of precheck reports
